title: Baicalin-Geniposide combination modulates microglia polarization against chronic cerebral ischemia and concomitant kidney injury via the HIF-1alpha/EPO/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Hu, Tian; Sun, Qianqian; Zhang, Jiahao; Zhou, Xuewei; Gong, Jie; Li, Yuan; Wang, Chuan; Liu, Jiping; Wang, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药组合对脑缺血及肾损伤的炎症调节作用，涉及HIF-1alpha/EPO/NF-kappaB通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，且方法仅含分子对接和湿实验，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Baicalin and geniposide combination (BC/GD), a traditional Chinese medicine pairing, is beneficial for chronic cerebral ischemia (CCI) and kidney injury, but the underlying mechanism remains unknown. METHODS: Using network pharmacology, we identified targets and pathways of BC/GD in CCI and kidney injury. Using molecular docking, we discovered the affinity between BC/GD and the key targets HIF-1alpha, EPOR, and TNF-alpha. Then, these were verified in SD rats and transwell co-cultures of HMC3 and HK-2 cells. RESULTS: Experimental validation demonstrated that BC/GD ameliorated cerebral and kidney pathological injury, cognitive impairment, and kidney dysfunction, increased cerebral blood flow, inhibited microglia activation and polarization of pro-inflammatory phenotypes, increased the expression of HIF-1alpha and EPOR, and reduced the phosphorylation of NF-kappaB and the level of pro-inflammatory factors in CCI rats. Then, in vitro validation experiments, we found that 12.5 muM and 25 muM BC/GD significantly increased the levels of anti-inflammatory factors and modulated the HIF-1alpha/EPO/NF-kappaB pathway in oxygen-glucose-deprived HMC3 and HK-2 cells, which was partially antagonized by PX-478, an inhibitor of HIF-1alpha. CONCLUSION: BC/GD alleviated cerebral and kidney inflammatory injury, and its mechanism may be related to the modulation of microglia polarization through HIF-1alpha/EPO/NF-kappaB.
abstract_zh: 背景：黄芩苷与栀子苷组合（BC/GD）是一种传统中药药对，对慢性脑缺血（CCI）和肾损伤有益，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。方法：利用网络药理学，我们确定了BC/GD在CCI和肾损伤中的靶点及通路。通过分子对接，我们发现了BC/GD与关键靶点HIF-1α、EPOR和TNF-α之间的亲和力。随后，在SD大鼠及HMC3和HK-2细胞的transwell共培养中进行了验证。结果：实验验证表明，BC/GD改善了脑和肾的病理损伤、认知障碍及肾功能障碍，增加了脑血流量，抑制了小胶质细胞活化及促炎表型的极化，增加了HIF-1α和EPOR的表达，并降低了CCI大鼠中NF-κB的磷酸化及促炎因子水平。在体外验证实验中，我们发现12.5 μM和25 μM的BC/GD显著增加了氧糖剥夺HMC3和HK-2细胞中抗炎因子的水平，并调节了HIF-1α/EPO/NF-κB通路，而这种效应被HIF-1α抑制剂PX-478部分拮抗。结论：BC/GD减轻了脑和肾的炎症损伤，其机制可能与通过HIF-1α/EPO/NF-κB调节小胶质细胞极化有关。
